anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: put to death the members on the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, idolatry, and the rest.
The Spirit giving life to mortal bodies — possible.

rejected: passion (Col 3:5 πάθος, not in the papyrus)
choices.why: Translate the word Origen wrote, not the fuller Pauline list.

pass_a_gloss: So that, day having come, he may be able to come out unhindered, he is commanded to be shod; and in this it also shows something more manifest about resurrection of flesh, it too coming out together with us as we go out of Egypt. For we must put to death the members upon the earth, fornication, uncleanness, wantonness, idolatry and the things next, and so come out of Egypt.
pass_b_english: So that, when day has come, he may be able to go out unhindered, he is commanded to be shod. And in this it also shows something clearer about the resurrection of flesh, it too coming out with us as we go out of Egypt. For we must put to death the members that are on the earth — fornication, uncleanness, wantonness, idolatry, and the rest — and so come out of Egypt (Colossians 3:5) (1 Corinthians 15:42–44) (Romans 8:11).
source_text: Ἵνα, ἡμέρας γενομένης, ἀνεμποδίστως ἐξελθεῖν δυνηθῇ, ὑποδεδέσθαι κελεύεται, ἐν τούτῳ δὲ καὶ ἐμφανέστερόν τι δηλοῖ τὰ περὶ ἀναστάσεως σαρκός, συνεξεργομένης καὶ αὐτῆς ἡμῖν τὴν Αἴγυπτον ἐξιοῦσιν· νεκρῶσαι γὰρ ἡμᾶς τὰ μέλη|| δεῖ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς πορνείαν ἀκαθαρσίαν ἀσέλγειαν εἰδωλολατρίαν καὶ τὰ ἑξῆ[ς] καὶ οὕτω τὴν Αἴγυπτον ἐξε[λθ]εῖν.
